status: Separate prospective diagnostic; no replacement of locked experiment or manuscript claims
question: How sensitive are main-hybrid768 C2 degradation and reselected C3 performance to the packet-extrema and zero-original-byte-rate rules?
motivating_evidence: Verified feature audit: 58242/74127 eligible records have directional maximum/total violations; 17354 have positive added bytes but zero byte rate; one has forward minimum above mean.
dataset: Exact verified 119571x70 original prepared matrix; no rows removed based on observed test results

changes.byte_lengths: Added directional packet length = declared byte increment / declared packet increment. Update directional and overall maximum/minimum with these added lengths, using original extrema. All other columns equal the historical operator. Under hybrid768, added lengths are 1184 forward and 1088 backward; this is an explicit synthetic packet allocation, not measured traffic.
changes.zero_byte_rate: Only eligible records whose original forward+backward byte total is zero: new byte rate = original Flow Pkts/s * new total bytes / original total packet count. Require positive original duration and packet rate. No duration-unit assumption; assumes the recorded packet rate has the same flow duration. Other rows/columns remain on the archived branches.

selection: 55 main candidates, archived train-only KS/Holm alpha .05 and MI >= .05; MI uses the original train values and archived 20000-row subsample rule. Recompute selection for every arm. Cache MI only when stable feature list and training data are identical.
models: Archived RF/XGB/MLP constructors, scaler fit only on original training data for the relevant columns. C1/C2 reuse one baseline fit per split/model. C3 fits are shared across arms only if ordered selected columns and original training rows are identical.
fit_count: 60 to 150 fits; 30 baseline fits plus 30 to 120 C3 fits. Reuse depends only on identical ordered feature lists, never on performance.
RF_prediction: n_jobs=1 for every diagnostic arm and C1; original fit constructor n_jobs=-1 retained. This prospective diagnostic setting is distinct from the historical reproduction workflow.
structural_gate: Before fitting: original-data and historical-shift hashes match verified records; no ineligible changes; finite values; combined arm introduces no violations under the nine length-bound and four rate-sign rules at the existing primary audit tolerances. Mean/total equalities remain separately reported semantic diagnostics.
historical_selection_gate: Each split historical stable/shifted lists, MI/KS values and selected order must agree with locked main records before that split is fitted.
statistics: Descriptive paired split-level weighted-F1 changes, mean/min/max; ROC-AUC and per-class F1 also saved. No new p-values, confidence intervals or equivalence decisions until the overlapping-split uncertainty review.
output: All 270 prediction/probability arrays, split positions, feature selection, fit-sharing IDs, structural counts, metrics, descriptive paired summaries, environment, hashes, warnings and logs.
preservation: New output directory; no checkpoint resume; original code/results unchanged.
limitations: Partial feature-level sensitivity, not full physical consistency
No packet trace, TLS framing, true PQC traffic or measured packetization
Timing, standard deviation/variance and subflow assumptions not repaired
Main representation and hybrid768 only; B3 and other footprints need separately scoped extensions if warranted
Inference from paired score changes concerns these implemented rules under fixed conditions, not all real PQC migration effects
authorship: Prepared with assistant assistance; explicit, inspectable new diagnostic code.
